decisions.decision: Use a unified three-column calculator: work categories, selectable price rows with quantities, and a visual total summary.
decisions.reason: Matches the approved detailing reference while preserving SIRIUS data and dark gold identity.

decisions.decision: Highlight selected and hovered plates with a left-to-right fading gold wash and a visible gold edge.
decisions.reason: Carries the detailing interaction motif into service cards, hero badges, and calculator rows.

decisions.decision: Open the price route with the full price list, place the calculator after it, and render the calculator as a compact dark layout without a containing background panel.
decisions.reason: Final user-selected revision: transparent outer container, dark controls, reduced calculator height.

decisions.decision: Remove service and booking lead paragraphs, keep all price accordions closed initially, and reduce the hero cashback badge to compact CTA scale.
decisions.reason: User requested faster access to the booking form and less introductory content.

decisions.decision: Make the pothole repair and asphalt crumb cards fully clickable 3D flip cards with opaque dark mini price tables and gold headers.
decisions.reason: Matches the supplied work-order tables and the established full price-list styling.

decisions.decision: Use a compact 2×2 service grid on laptops and phones, with concise front descriptions and shortened work names on the flip side.
decisions.reason: The user prioritizes seeing all four services together and removing unused vertical space while retaining essential pricing content.

decisions.decision: Replace the cashback plate with three border-only guarantee, budget, and compliance benefits.
decisions.reason: Keeps the hero focused on the company's main customer promises without another heavy card surface.
